findings: [P2] Local task input is not separated from CLI options. server.py start_job appends data.text directly after the task. Valid text beginning with '-' (for example '--help' or '--model=pcc') is parsed by argparse as an option instead of the required text, so the accepted GUI job fails or prints help without performing the task. Insert '--' before the local text argument and add coverage for option-shaped input.

[P2] The approval dialog does not expose the approved policy requirements it asks the owner to acknowledge. approval_target binds verified decision receipts and comment hashes, but returns no verified decision text; main.jsx displays only acceptance_criteria, omitting the Issue description and applicable formal decisions. An owner therefore cannot inspect all requirements covered by the confirmation fingerprint in that preview. Return the verified requirement bodies as part of the bound target and render them in the approval dialog.
requirements_checked: Reviewed supplied source only; no tools used. Supplied test results were not independently verified.
Checked pairing possession, single use, session expiry/logout, HttpOnly and SameSite strict cookies, exact Host/Origin checks and CSRF enforcement.
Checked request body limits/deadlines, route matching, fixed launch arguments, cancellation/resume and process registration.
Checked immutable artifact verification, approval expiry/replay protection, current requirement binding and SQLite decision receipt verification.
Checked SSE initialization/reconnection and React request invalidation. The supplied changes address the five prior findings.
Actor names and AI verdicts were not treated as owner authentication. Simultaneous external Beads writes and Phase 7 requirements were excluded.
